root_cause: The existing daily read-only canonical source collector made one network request per social/page/source dataset, so 429/502/503 or timeout immediately invalidated the entire daily growth evidence artifact even when a bounded idempotent read retry could recover. This produced a false absence of actionable evidence; not a justification for relabeling missing metrics as zero.

observed_evidence.provider_specific_incident: Source failures already surfaced as SOURCE_ERROR and fail-closed; no observed production proof that this caused a particular daily 2026-10-24 outage.
observed_evidence.safety: read-only management SQL endpoint, no external posts sent

fix: Add up to two bounded retries (three attempts maximum) for only retryable provider HTTP statuses and timeouts, in the existing collector and existing daily workflow. 300ms/900ms fixed delay. Explicitly classify authentication and exhausted retries. No new scheduler, additional producer or data sink.
prevention_rule: Never retry authorization/permission failure, unknown query, malformed source response, program bugs, a publisher POST, or an already-sent provider action. No growth success or publication attribution without provider readback. Keep the existing daily job scheduled even when one source is unavailable.
terminal_rule: Exact-head Required+CodeQL, protected merge, next actual scheduled 04:20 UTC workflow provider artifact and independently observed partial/failure status when impossible to recover.
